name: Steelgrill's Depot
summary: East of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot keeps Alliance vehicles and machinery working. Beldin Steelgrill and his crew repair them, supply tinkerers, and salvage what they can.

sections.title: A Bastion of Steam and Steel
sections.body: Just off the snowy road, dwarven miners and eccentric gnome engineers gather among heavy machinery, mechanized walking frames, and raw ore from nearby quarries. Metal clanks, steam vents hiss, and experimental engines churn. Trogg disruptions and shortages of mechanical supplies trouble Dun Morogh. In the bitter cold, travelers come for spare parts or technical guidance.

faq.answer: Steelgrill's Depot sits just down the road east of Kharanos. It is a workshop and outpost in Dun Morogh, where miners, tinkerers, and field technicians tend heavy machinery.
Beldin Steelgrill manages the depot with his fellow dwarven and gnomish crafters. Together, they maintain the surrounding machinery and oversee mining operations.
The depot has trade suppliers, repair services, and trainers who help craftsmen hone their engineering and gathering skills in the field.

angles.text: As an aspiring engineer traveling through Dun Morogh, you can rest at this open-air laboratory, surrounded by steam machinery and tinkering supplies.
As a gnome, you may work with your dwarven hosts at the depot. Exiled gnomish tinkers often use its forge fires and spare components to keep their salvaged contraptions running.
